scheme_name: Incentive To Owners Of Artificial Insemination Born Female Calf Through Pure Breeding In Indigenous Cow
other_conditions: Applicant must be the owner of a female calf born through artificial insemination by pure breeding in indigenous cows.
The calf must be not more than 11 months old at the date of the online application.
Benefit is eligible only once per year for a maximum of one calf per beneficiary.
benefits_summary: An incentive of ₹3,000 is provided once per year to owners of a qualifying female calf.
